description: This source file implements the RemoveByAnd class, which is a specific entity operation within the MiniLang mechanism of the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles the <remove-by-and> XML element, enabling the removal of entities based on combined conditions.

classes.name: RemoveByAnd
classes.description: Represents the <remove-by-and> element which performs delete operations on entities matching specified conditions within the OFBiz MiniLang framework.

methods.name: RemoveByAnd
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RemoveByAnd operation with XML element configuration and the parent SimpleMethod context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the remove-by-and operation, removing entities matching the specified conditions using the Delegator.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information such as entity name for documentation or analysis purposes.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RemoveByAnd object, mainly for debugging purposes.
